glossary.role: Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).
glossary.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".

glossary.role: Zeon remnant force led by Aiguille Delaz that carries out Operation Stardust in U.C. 0083.
Common short name of the Unified Empire of Giganos
The former Zeon fortress Solomon, renamed by the Federation; site of the 0083 naval review that Gato attacks.
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).
glossary.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".

glossary.role: Earth's name for the unknown Jovian enemy (actually the Jovian Federation, 木連).
Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).
glossary.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.

report.translator_summary: Completed translation of op05_02 (65 rows), completing Operation 05. Covers Phase 2 mission dialogue (battle against Cima Garahau and Giganos reinforcements, Delaz's broadcast revealing UCE's nuclear violation, Cima's withdrawal), debriefing with Commodore John Cowen, and two detailed intelligence reports (Preventer report on the Delaz Fleet and upcoming Konpei Island naval review, and UCE Intelligence analysis of the recovered satellite revealing the mysterious E2 Substance).

uncertainties.note: Term 'Ｅ２物質' translated as 'E2 Substance', aligning with project study documentation notes on the mysterious pre-war energy source.
